scenarios.name: Reopen customization after choosing another target without editing

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the Part | Tools and Part | Manage custom targets are empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the ribbon customization target is "Part | Tools"
the user selects "Part | Manage" as the target
the user closes customization without editing any commands
the user opens Customize from Tools again
the ribbon customization target is "Part | Tools"
the target command list is empty
